Recall the following special limit: 

$$
e={lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}
$$

Now, we rewrite the given limit using the algebra of limits, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n/3} & ={lim}_{n\to \infty }{[{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}]}^{1/3} \\  & ={[{lim}_{n\to \infty }{(1+\frac{1}{n})}^{n}]}^{1/3} \\  & ={e}^{1/3} \\  & =\sqrt[3]{e}\end{aligned}
$$
